sources.citation: Maho, Jouni Filip. 2009. NUGL Online: the online version of the New Updated Guthrie List. 120 pp.
Van der Veen, Lolke J. 1991. Etude comparée des parlers du groupe okani B30 (Gabon). Thèse, Université Lumière Lyon 2. 469 pp.
sources.note: Image-only scan (no text layer, not scanned); covers the B30 Tsogo/Okani group, not Ivili B503 — kept only because Ivili of Sindara borders this group.

sources.citation: Niama Niama, Japhet. 2025. The Evolution of Noun Prefixes in West-Coastal Bantu Languages of Gabon. Languages 10(6): 144. doi:10.3390/languages10060144.
sources.note: Ivili B503 not in the sample; nothing on it.

sources.citation: Niama Niama, Japhet. 2021. Approche historico-comparative des langues bantu du Gabon: vers de nouveaux embranchements phonologiques partagés entre les groupes B50-60-70. Thèse de doctorat, Université Lumière Lyon 2. 361 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on Ivili: p.31 (PDF p.38) states imwele B502 and ivili B503 are excluded because they 'sont inconnues du point de vue des descriptions linguistiques' and existing lexical data are insufficient. Phonology chapters cover nine other B50-60-70 languages only.

sources.citation: Pacchiarotti, Sara, Natalia Chousou-Polydouri & Koen Bostoen. 2019. Untangling the West-Coastal Bantu mess: identification, geography and phylogeny of the Bantu B50-80 languages. Africana Linguistica 25: 155-229. doi:10.2143/AL.25.0.3287234 (accepted-version proofs, UGent biblio).
sources.note: Nothing; lexicon-based phylogeny. States their B503 Vili data are '(v) a wordlist of Vili B503 from the Laboratoire Dynamique du Langage (DDL) at the Université de Lyon' (Sindara).

sources.citation: Van der Veen, Lolke J. 2014. Langues et dialectes du Gabon: cognats et reconstructions. Base de données en ligne (version évolutive). Laboratoire Dynamique du Langage, Lyon. 387 pp.
sources.note: Lists ALGAB variety 'B503 vili de Sindara' and cites its lexical forms in cognate sets; no prosodic or phonological description.

sources.citation: Hombert, J.-M., D. Comas, P. Mouguiama, L. Quintana-Murci, L. Sica & L. Van der Veen. 2006. The Fang enigma (slides); Mouguiama-Daouda, Hombert & Van der Veen n.d., Aspects of linguistic diversity in western Central Africa (poster); Van der Veen 2007 Porquerolles slides.
sources.note: No Ivili content beyond inventory maps.

sources.citation: Van der Veen, Lolke J. 2006. La situation linguistique du Gabon: état des recherches. Presentation, MRAC Tervuren, 2-3 Feb 2006. 16 pp.
sources.note: Inventory only: 'ivili B503 (KM/H)' i.e. wordlist data (Kwenzi-Mikala/Hombert); nothing on stress.
